m3iq_policy.required_provenance_wording: targets offline-derived via MediaPipe Holistic; runtime uses only our scratch-trained model and is not a runtime dependency.

required_limitations: Use only original game-category raw video archives.
Do not ship any pretrained detector, landmark, embedding, feature model, or browser runtime dependency.

candidate_only_sources.reason: Approved only after clip-level consent and required evidence; no M3IW packet-specific first-party clip list or derived-label scope exists.

offline_label_sidecar_contract.required_provenance_disclosure: targets offline-derived via MediaPipe Holistic; runtime uses only our scratch-trained model and is not a runtime dependency.

against_m3ir_target_contract: Every sidecar uses exactly the four coarse region target ids from M3IR.
Region boxes are normalized full-frame top-left xyxy values in [0, 1].
Each hand target has 21 landmarks in the M3IR order when present.
Hand landmarks include crop-normalized and full-frame mapped coordinates.
Occlusion, truncation, visibility, and presence fields are retained.
against_m3it_recognizer_sequence_plan: Source frame order is monotonic within each isolated-sign attempt.
Future tensors would be able to sample or pad to the 32-timestep planning default without dropping source frame ids.
Feature components can produce the planned 220 numeric features without masks.
Mask tensors remain separate from numeric features.
Missingness and absence rules match zero-fill plus false masks.
not_performed_by_this_contract: No compatibility audit is run because no packet sidecars exist yet.
No tensor shape validation is run because no tensors are created.
No recognizer input implementation is added.

split_constraints: Do not place the same signer, clip, or leakage group in multiple project splits.
Keep source_split_id and project_split_id side by side in every manifest row.
Report class and target coverage by source split and project split.
signer_disjoint_proof: Every signer_id_or_pseudonymous_group_id maps to exactly one project split.
Unknown signer identity must be treated as a leakage risk and grouped conservatively.
The future receipt must include counts of signer groups by split.
duplicate_frame_handling: Duplicates may remain only within the same split unless a future receipt justifies otherwise.
Exact and near-duplicate frame counts must be reported before training/evaluation.
negative_no_hand_accounting: No-hand, low-light, off-center, false-trigger, false-no-hand, and non-target signing rows require source approval before inclusion.
Negative/no-hand rows must have explicit target absence masks rather than missing rows.
Counts must be reported by source, split, target, and reason.
two_hand_and_contact_cases: left_or_first_hand and right_or_second_hand are target ids, not biometric identity claims.
When hands contact or cross, preserve both hand targets when visible and set occlusion/low-visibility flags.
If only one hand is visible, encode the missing hand with the absence rules rather than copying the visible hand.
human_review_sample_requirements: Sample every coarse region target and both hand landmark targets.
Include examples across source splits, signer groups, canonical labels, two-hand contact, one-hand visible, no-hand, occlusion, truncation, low visibility, and off-center cases where present.
Record reviewer role, review date, sample selection method, pass/fail counts, corrections, and unresolved issues.
Do not treat unreviewed sidecars as authoritative packet evidence.

validation_prerequisites_before_later_ma: Dataset source register parses and retains PopSign offline-derived label authority.
Source manifest contract exists and binds every raw clip/frame reference to source authority, split, signer, and checksum fields.
Offline-label sidecar contract exists and binds every label row to labeler method/version/config/run id, source clip/frame, coordinates, confidence, visibility, manual review, and provenance wording.
Checksum manifest covers raw clips, frame references, sidecars, split files, human review receipts, and attribution metadata.
Coordinate compatibility audit passes against M3IR and M3IT.
Split/leakage audit proves signer, clip, source, and duplicate-frame isolation.
Negative/no-hand accounting is explicit and source-approved.
Human-review sample receipt exists before sidecars are treated as authoritative.
Claim surfaces remain fail-closed until separate training, evaluation, export, promotion, and browser parity receipts exist.

before_packet_materialization: This contract alone does not authorize importing source media or writing packet rows.
A source manifest contract and label sidecar contract must be reviewed first.
before_training_or_evaluation: No tensors, checkpoints, training commands, or evaluation commands are authorized by this contract.
Training/evaluation can only consume a future authoritative packet with completed source, sidecar, checksum, split, coordinate, and review receipts.
before_brev_spend: No Brev runtime, remote command, start, stop, sync, exec, or copy action is authorized.
Any future Brev work requires a separate bounded compute receipt and explicit human approval.
before_export_promotion_browser_activati: No browser artifact path may be populated.
Active recognition labels must remain empty.
No final gate may be weakened or changed by this contract.
